mapper.insert: INSERT INTO users SET name = #{name}, login_id = #{loginId}, login_pw = #{loginPw}, postcode = #{postcode}, address = #{address}, address_detail = #{addressDetail}, phone = #{phone}, email = #{email}, image_path = #{imagePath}, role = #{role}
mapper.select: SELECT u.id, u.name, u.login_id, u.postcode, u.address, u.address_detail, u.phone, u.email, u.image_path, u.role, u.created, COUNT(o.id) AS orders FROM users u LEFT JOIN orders o ON o.user_id = u.id WHERE u.id = #{userId} GROUP BY u.id
